verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a developer platform like GitHub, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a self-hostable GitHub deployment; every doc describes cloud-hosted services. Community items only mention self-hosting competitors such as Forgejo, or wanting self-hosted CI runners, which is an adjacent capability and not the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
